我日你先人.definition: It means “fuck your ancestors”, [probably] used to abuse others.It's well known by a clip from a famous Anti-Japanese TV series 亮剑（Liang Jian）,which has spread widely on the [Chinese] [Internet].
我日你先人.example:
山本，我日你先人
[Yamamoto],I'll [fuck] your ancestors.

我爸是李刚 \"My dad is Li Gang!\".definition: It's usually used satirically. It's a popular saying in China that has come to symbolize [corruption]. Specifically, the arrogant notion of some children of the [privileged] class that their parents' clout shields them from suffering the [consequences] of their misconduct
我爸是李刚 \"My dad is Li Gang!\".example:
[Grocery Store] Owner: "Hey kid! Pay for that candy bar, or else I'll [call the cops]!"

Kid ([running away] with candy bar): "Screw you! 我爸是李刚 "My dad is Li Gang!"
